Management targets operating EBITDA margin of 16.5%-17% in H2 FY25 and aims to exit FY25 at that level.
Management expects to sustain the Q1 top-line revenue momentum in the remaining quarters of FY25.
Q1 FY25 operating EBITDA margin was 15.2%, down 80 bps QoQ due to one-time hits including US project ramp delays and Middle East PDD.
US geography EBIT margin dropped to 3% in Q1 from 9% in Q4 due to holding resources for delayed project starts; management targets double-digit US margins in H2 FY25.
12-month order book backlog flat QoQ but up 23% YoY; Q1 typically slower for order book but pipeline building is strong.
Depreciation & amortization in Q1 reflects regular run-rate after one-time useful life alignment for acquired intangibles in prior quarter; incremental increase expected with future capex.
UK public sector business sees clarity post-elections; Labour manifesto on NHS, health, defence programs aligns with Mastek focus; early signs of deal movement in revenue & customs, justice, DVLA.
Confident in sustaining healthy topline growth and profitability in coming quarters
12-month order backlog grew 17.9% YoY and 1.2% QoQ in INR terms (flat in constant currency); 14 new customers onboarded in Q2 FY25.
Operating EBITDA margin improved 125 bps QoQ to 16.5% in Q2 FY25, after partial wage hike impact; full wage hike impact expected in Q3.
Management targets EBITDA margin of 17-18%; expects consistent improvement with Q4 in line of sight despite Q3 wage hike and furlough headwinds.
Full quarter wage hike impact of 120-130 bps expected in Q3 FY25; management aims to absorb significant portion via operating levers.
North America margins expanding with growth; target to reach mid-teens by end of FY25 and double digits in coming quarters.
Company does not provide formal revenue guidance; sees market as cautiously optimistic but notes Q3 furlough season and macro uncertainties.
Significant investments in Gen AI capabilities including training, tooling, partnerships, and NVIDIA collaboration for enterprise AI platform targeting Q4 FY25 launch.
Utilization at 85.6% (down 90 bps QoQ); bench actively managed; headcount additions planned as growth requires but no current risk to revenue delivery.
Expect to drive higher efficiency in delivery execution over next four quarters using AI enabled platforms and tools
